pairs.notes: All names (Astoria, Jock Head, Tully Castle, Petrorus Point, North Mountain Breakers, Thunderer's Guardian) are kept. Left out as borderline paraphrases: 'without complaint' -> 'silently', and 'missing from his life' -> 'left out of his story'. 'no one could see him well' -> 'nobody could clearly spot him' keeps the same polarity.

other: Heading concept 'moral hazard' is replaced by 'hidden risks', so the named economic concept is dropped
pairs.notes: The '3.' list marker is in both texts, so no number changed. 'did not fit standard criteria' -> 'failed to meet standard risk or return guidelines' keeps the polarity. Left out as borderline: 'believing them highly-rated' -> 'thinking they were safe' (rating vs safety), and 'lent out again' -> 'reused' (the lending is not stated).
Emily, Washington D.C. and early April are kept. Left out as synonym-level changes: barn -> shed, quaint -> small, orchard -> grove, dawn -> morning, 'morning routine' -> 'daily schedule'.

other: 'reconsider the role of bicycles' becomes the garbled 'explore the focused of bikes', so the call to reconsider their role is lost
'balance urban development with sustainable practices' becomes 'achieve urban growth with sustainable initiatives', so the idea of balancing two aims is lost
'reliance on private vehicles increasing with economic growth' becomes '...personal vehicles on with economic advancement', so the claim that car reliance increases with growth is lost
'public bicycles would be instrumental' becomes 'public public would be vital', so the subject (bicycles) is lost
pairs.notes: The rewrite is partly garbled ('to to', 'an rise', 'public public'). 'numerous' and 'significantly -> greatly' are kept. 'commuting reliance' -> 'journeys reliance' is a minor shift and I did not count it separately.

quantifiers: numerous ecological benefits -> ecological advantages (numerous dropped)
other: The call to 'reconsider the role of bicycles in our daily lives' is reduced to 'emphasizing the importance of bicycles', so 'reconsider' and 'in our daily lives' are dropped
'public bicycles would be instrumental' (conditional) becomes 'public bicycles serve as a potent tool' (stated as fact)
pairs.notes: Left out as borderline: 'commuting reliance on private vehicles' -> 'personal vehicle usage' (commuting dropped, reliance -> usage); 'we strive to balance' -> 'we aim to harmonize'; 'significantly' -> 'pivotal' (same strength). No names or numbers in either text.

other: The wax seal on the parcel ('fresh white wax seal affixed') is dropped
'floor' is added: the fingers rest on 'a carpeted floor' and the parcel is 'placed neatly on the floor', whereas the original has no floor and the parcel 'lay before him'
'fell silent and heavy' becomes 'ceased to move and rested', so 'heavy' is lost
The surface changes from 'carpeting of white paint stretched far over dark ceilings' to 'a carpeted floor covered by white paint', with different spatial meaning
pairs.notes: 'there wasn't anything left to be done but' -> 'There was nothing else to do but' keeps the polarity. Singular 'ceiling' vs plural 'ceilings' is not counted as a quantifier change.

The meaning is preserved. Left out as borderline: 'mantenimiento periódico' -> 'revisión regular' (maintenance narrowed to inspection); 'tensión de operación' -> 'presión eléctrica en funcionamiento' (odd term for voltage); 'interferencia eléctrica' -> 'ruido electromagnético'; 'seguridad ... garantizarse' -> 'protección ... mantenerse'. 'menos frecuentes' -> 'menos común' and 'especialmente' -> 'en especial' keep the same strength.

other: 'high performance at low latency' is garbled to 'very highly at low low', so the performance and latency requirement is lost
'should be instant' becomes 'should be within', so the instant-response requirement is lost
'other database tables' becomes 'other a set', so the database tables are lost
'a hash table would be ideal' becomes 'a hash a would be perfect', so the data structure name is lost
pairs.notes: The '1.' list marker is in both. 'without additional complications' -> 'without additional extra' keeps 'without', so no polarity flip. 'Performance Requirements' -> 'Speed Requirements' is a heading synonym.

other: 'overnight' is dropped: 'worthless overnight' becomes 'worthless within', so the timing claim is lost
'came crashing down when' becomes 'collapsed ... because', so a temporal link becomes a causal one
'it sought rescue from international investors' becomes 'it to rescue from global investors', so the verb is lost and the sentence is ungrammatical
'lost $6 billion' becomes 'suffered $6 billion' and 'Lehman's bankruptcy' becomes 'Lehman's collapse' (small shifts)
pairs.notes: $6 billion appears in both. Bear Stearns and Lehman are in both. 'investment arm' -> 'venture arm' and 'confidence' -> 'trust' are treated as synonym-level. 'All' is kept ('It all').

other: The 'gestora' (the interim management body) is rendered as 'la dirección' and then as 'la figura encargada' (a single person), so the subject changes from a body to a figure, although 'La gestora' returns later

Final sentence: 'la credibilidad del proyecto dependerá de su capacidad' becomes 'su confianza dependerá de la capacidad de la dirección', so what depends on what changes; 'conscientes de que' (aware that) becomes 'ya que' (because)
pairs.notes: No numbers. Names (Partido Socialista Obrero Español, PSOE, España, Gobierno en funciones) are all present in both; PSOE just appears twice in the rewrite. Negations ('no se limita' -> 'no se reduce', 'sin renunciar' -> 'sin abandonar') keep the polarity. 'Algunos/otros', 'cualquier' and 'una parte' are unchanged. Left out as borderline: 'debate' -> 'conflicto' (a bit stronger); 'mayorías parlamentarias' -> 'bloques parlamentarios'; 'pasar factura' -> 'costar votos'; 'dimisión de su anterior secretario general' -> 'salida de su antiguo jefe' (title lost, though the original also says 'salida' elsewhere); 'se ha propuesto preparar' -> 'ha anunciado', and 'anunciado' -> 'confirmado'; 'ilusionar' -> 'atraer'; 'electorado' -> 'público'; 'debate interno' -> 'reuniones internas'; 'asumió el control' -> 'tomó el poder'.
